title: Route Optimization under Port Congestion and Carbon Reduction: An NSGA-II Approach
abstract: arXiv:2611.22705v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Maritime shipping simultaneously faces the dual challenges of escalating port congestion and increasingly stringent decarbonization mandates. Large-scale vessel anchorage at hub ports inflates unit transport costs while generating significant additional \(CO_2\) emissions from idling auxiliary engines. This study develops a multi-objective routing optimization framework that jointly incorporates time, transport, and carbon emission costs under congestion-dependent generalized cost functions. A variational inequality (VI) model is formulated to characterize network equilibrium in vessel route allocation, while the Non-dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm II (NSGA-II) is deployed to solve the resulting three-objective optimization problem. translated_title: 港口拥堵与碳减排下的航线优化：基于NSGA-II的方法
translated_abstract: 海运业同时面临港口拥堵日益加剧和脱碳要求日趋严格的双重挑战。大量船舶在枢纽港口锚泊不仅推高了单位运输成本，还因辅助发动机怠速运转产生了大量额外的二氧化碳排放。本研究开发了一个多目标航线优化框架，在拥堵相关的广义成本函数下，联合考虑时间、运输和碳排放三类成本。研究构建了变分不等式（VI）模型来刻画船舶航线分配中的网络均衡，并采用非支配排序遗传算法II（NSGA-II）求解由此形成的三目标优化问题。该模型以中国沿海集装箱网络为实证进行了验证（上海作为主要拥堵港口，宁波-舟山作为备选替代港口），并开展了相应的敏感性分析。
tldr: 本文提出一个融合变分不等式网络均衡模型与NSGA-II算法的多目标航线优化框架，联合最小化时间、运输与碳排放成本，并以中国沿海集装箱网络（上海为主要拥堵港、宁波-舟山为替代港）实证验证了港口拥堵与碳减排双重约束下的船舶航线分配方案。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a multi-objective routing optimization framework integrating a variational inequality network equilibrium model with NSGA-II to jointly minimize time, transport, and carbon emission costs, empirically validated on China's coastal container network under dual pressures of port congestion and decarbonization.
